verdict: Paid leads are flowing at a fair price, but the brand engine around them is underbuilt.
diagnosis: Meta lead ads produced 196 leads at $27.90 each this period — right at industry norms, but Instagram presence and organic reach remain thin.

signals.headline: 196 leads at $27.90 each
signals.detail: Meta lead forms delivered steady volume this period at a cost close to the projected legal benchmark.

signals.headline: 145 new 5-star reviews landed
signals.detail: Google reviews grew to 937 total at a perfect 5.0 average — a major trust signal for prospects.

signals.headline: 126 calls from Google profile
signals.detail: The Google Business Profile drove direct phone leads this period without any paid support behind it.

signals.headline: Only 28 Instagram followers
signals.detail: The paid account has almost no organic audience, so every lead depends on ad spend continuing.

signals.headline: 1,121 landing page views logged
signals.detail: Roughly 1 in 6 landing page viewers became a lead this period — a healthy form conversion rate.

benchmark.label: Benchmark
benchmark.body: <cite index="1-8">Cost per lead for law firms is expected to rise from about $18 in 2025 to roughly $21 in 2026 on Meta.</cite> Justice Consumer Law's $27.90 sits slightly above that but well under broader legal medians.

seasonal.label: Seasonal
seasonal.subheader: Summer competition pushing click costs up
seasonal.body: <cite index="10-5">Facebook cost per click rose 11% year-over-year to $1.72 in 2026</cite>, with legal among the most expensive verticals. Expect gradual pressure on cost per lead through summer.

competitor.label: Competitor
competitor.body: <cite index="17-9,17-10,17-11">Firms running generic "we handle all legal matters" campaigns are seeing cost-per-case climb while conversion rates decline, while firms marketing each practice area separately are capturing higher-intent traffic.</cite>

recommendations.title: Test a debt-harassment-specific ad angle
recommendations.detail: Consider splitting the current general video into a dedicated debt collector harassment creative. Specific messaging tends to lower cost per qualified lead versus broad legal messaging.

recommendations.title: Feature the 937 five-star reviews in creative
recommendations.detail: Worth testing an ad variant that leads with the review count and rating. Social proof at this scale is rare and can lift form conversion meaningfully.

recommendations.title: Build the Instagram feed to support the ads
recommendations.detail: With only 28 followers, prospects who check the profile see an empty account. Test posting client wins and short educational clips weekly.
